0022600085.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Atlanta Hawks visit the Orlando Magic, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Atlanta a 45% chance to win. For the Hawks, Henri Veesaar is out with a knee injury, and Mouhamed Gueye is day-to-day with a foot fracture and a game-time decision. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (out, hamstring), while Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Franz Wagner (shoulder soreness), Jase Richardson (back soreness), and Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Atlanta won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 130-101 win in Orlando on April 1, 2026, which was their most recent meeting.
